population: Wikimedia Commons Picture of the Day, 2018-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive
identity_comparison_scope: Exact metadata identifiers only. Commons page IDs are namespaced and never compared as bare COCO/DIV2K integers. Provided SHA1 cannot be compared to prior SHA256 without future acquisition.
limitations: Curated POTD frame; not representative of all natural images.
Creator grouping uses the complete normalized metadata string, not independently verified human identity.
No pixels or thumbnails fetched, viewed, decoded or processed. No visual deduplication, descriptor screening or proof of unseen content.
Mirrored files, alternate URLs, near duplicates and shared scenes may remain.
Future authorized acquisition must exclude exact raw/canonical hashes against existing records before scientific use.
POTD and file metadata/licences are mutable; preserved API responses identify the draw-time evidence.
Explicit official public-domain statuses may lack LicenseUrl; null is recorded rather than an invented URL.
Neither metadata selection nor this manifest approves execution, pays compute, warrants licences or proves ownership.
reserve_policy: Before any scientific outcome, replace only acquisition/licence/identity failures using next frozen reserve; retain receipts. After outcomes begin, no replacements and missing attempts stay in denominator. Fewer than 200 acquired eligible sources means incomplete confirmation.
